description.translate: I've been studying mechanical workshops. Shafts, gears, steam engines... Clever stuff. Dangerous too, if you don't respect it. Bring me twelve copper ingots. I want to rebuild the damaged fittings before trying anything ambitious.

Good copper. That's a start. Professor Voss warned me that the blade's sonic vibration could break the test fittings even with the furnace cooling. I laughed at the warning. After that accident, I owed him an apology. Ask him to show you the readings.
